summary: Revision 1 matches the authorized new design system, Figma file, and dedicated project. It bounds the foundation to three token layers, Light/Dark modes, and 44 variants across six families; assigns separate authorship, contract review, Figma construction, and final review; and requires live placement, inventory, bindings, and visual evidence. It preserves repository tokens as the source and does not claim Draft placement, library publication, or runtime UI proof. The blank Figma Home is an access dependency with an explicit incomplete outcome if project creation remains unavailable.
